name: Oliver Wyman
seo_title: Oliver Wyman case interview: what to expect
description: What Oliver Wyman's own careers pages say about its conversational and case interviews, in the UK and other countries, each line linked to its source.
intro: This guide sums up what Oliver Wyman's own careers pages say about applying and interviewing, from how to apply in the UK to how Oliver Wyman suggests you prepare. It reflects those pages as we checked them on 16 October 2026. Processes differ by programme, role and country, so check Oliver Wyman's careers site for your role before you apply.

sections.heading: How to apply in the UK

items.text: For its London entry-level consultant role, Oliver Wyman asks applicants to submit a CV and a cover letter.
Oliver Wyman says its London Summer Internship 2027 is for penultimate-year students currently studying for a bachelor's or master's degree.
Oliver Wyman's entry-level interview preparation page says its interview process is a mix of conversational interviews and case interviews.
Oliver Wyman says conversational interviews are your chance to talk about your background, interests and career objectives, and also to ask questions about the firm.
Oliver Wyman describes the case interview as an interactive exercise in analytical thinking, often based on real-world challenges, that lets it assess how you approach and evaluate a problem.
Oliver Wyman advises thinking of your case interviewer as your client, who wants you to solve the problem and can help you do so.

For entry-level roles in Germany, Oliver Wyman asks for a CV, a cover letter and all relevant certificates, including the Abitur school-leaving certificate, and says it replies within one to two weeks.
Oliver Wyman Germany says its selection days are always held on Fridays and mostly take place virtually.
Oliver Wyman Germany says internship candidates have two one-to-one interviews on the selection day and full-time candidates have four, each including a case study and a personal part.

Oliver Wyman says its campus recruiting process in Brazil and Mexico typically includes an online assessment of 26 questions in 50 minutes, entirely in English, covering critical reasoning, problem solving, data sufficiency and integrated reasoning, with instructions emailed the day before.
Oliver Wyman says the Brazil and Mexico process then has a 15-minute fit interview in English with no case, followed by two rounds of two case interviews each, conducted partly in English.
Oliver Wyman says every stage of its Brazil and Mexico campus process is eliminatory and that the whole process, from assessments to final interviews, runs virtually.

For its Consultant Accelerator Program in South Africa, Oliver Wyman says the recruitment process includes three interviews with its consultants and partners, assessing problem-solving skills, quantitative thinking and cultural fit.
For students and recent graduates, Oliver Wyman says it values initiative, intuition, creativity and a strong problem-solving mindset, and welcomes all academic majors or industry experience.
For its UK and Ireland entry-level roles and internships, Oliver Wyman says you do not need a specific degree subject or previous industry experience.

Oliver Wyman says a case interview explores whether you can evaluate and use data, think creatively, apply common sense to complex business problems, ask the right questions and communicate your ideas.

sections.heading: How Oliver Wyman suggests you prepare

items.text: Oliver Wyman advises starting a case by thinking about the scenario, asking clarifying questions and summarising the situation in your own words.
Oliver Wyman advises breaking the problem into smaller parts, putting your first thoughts on paper, diagramming your ideas and asking for any extra information you need.
Oliver Wyman advises showing your quantitative skills in the case while taking care with simple calculations.
Oliver Wyman advises ending with a recommendation that summarises your key findings, answers the key issues and says what the client should do.
Oliver Wyman's interview preparation page offers six case interview practice samples.

practice_advice: Practise saying your structure out loud before you start any analysis, so the interviewer can follow your plan.
Do short, timed mental maths drills most days, with pen and paper only. Mock Partner's drills cover mental maths, chart reading and market sizing.
After each practice case, write down one thing to do better and choose your next case to work on it.
